title: The Master
overview: John Peter McAllister, an American veteran, is the only American ever accepted for training as a ninja. He finally leaves his clan to seek out his daughter in America. The ninja consider his abandoning them dishonorable and send one of their own, Osaka, to kill McAllister. Meanwhile, McAllister makes the acquaintance of a young wannabe knight errant, Max Keller, and agrees to train him in the ways of the ninja. As they travel the U.S. in Max's van, Max and McAllister help those that they meet.

episodes.title: Max
episodes.overview: After being attacked by Ninja's in Japan, John Peter McAllister heads to America to search for his daugher. He encounters Max who gives him assistance then offers to help him find his daughter if he will teach him his ninja skills. With the search for his daughter just getting underway, John McAllister is sidetracked by a ruthless land developer who has a local sheriff in his pocket.

episodes.overview: Max and John travel to a nightclub in search of clues to the location of Johns daughter. They find the nightclub owner being threatened by business men who are running a protection racket. John and Max then decide to help the owner of the club.
